name: Ecosystems of STEM Careers High School Internship
org: The Raptor Center, University of Minnesota
what_you_do: Ten interns spend four weeks exploring STEM careers. There are four field trips, and lunch once a week on trip days.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 10 to 12 who attend a public school (or public tuition free charter) in Minneapolis or Saint Paul. The page says no exceptions at this time.
duration: 4 weeks (June 15 to July 10 in 2026), Monday to Friday 9 am to 3 pm
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 3, 2026, with interviews in mid April. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The page does not describe the steps. Call 612-624-4745.
notes: Grant funded. Students must commit to the whole program.
